Package com.composum.sling.platform.testing.testutil

Class ErrorCollectorAlwaysPrintingFailures

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.testing.testutil.ErrorCollectorAlwaysPrintingFailures
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.junit.rules.MethodRule
    public class ErrorCollectorAlwaysPrintingFailures
extends Object
implements org.junit.rules.MethodRule
    Extends JUnit's ErrorCollector so that it also prints failed checks even when we have an exception in the test, since these might contain important information about the why of the exception. All throwables are wrapped into a MultipleFailureException if neccesary.

    This implements MethodRule instead of TestRule since they have precedence and we want e.g. to print the JCR content on failures before the SlingContext rule shuts the JCR down.
